svg.title: Dead reckoning with and without convergence
svg.desc: A cursor's x position over three seconds of a 30 Hz stream with two long bursts of packet loss. Without convergence the track snaps by up to 487 px in one rendered frame when a burst ends. With 120 ms convergence the worst frame-to-frame jump is 39 px, at the cost of staying off the real position slightly longer.
svg.text: Worst jump in one 120 Hz frame: 487 px without convergence, 39 px with it. The price is staying off the real position for about 120 ms longer after a burst.
